steps.title: Induce anesthesia with isoflurane
steps.instruction: Place the mouse in an isoflurane induction chamber and deliver isoflurane until loss of righting reflex is observed.

steps.title: Transfer mouse to stereotaxic frame
steps.instruction: Move the anesthetized mouse onto a Kopf Instruments stereotaxic frame equipped with a mouse nose cone to maintain anesthesia during the procedure.

steps.title: Maintain isoflurane anesthesia and monitor breathing
steps.instruction: Continue isoflurane delivery throughout surgery, continuously monitor breathing rate, and adjust isoflurane level as needed to keep anesthesia stable.

steps.title: Place mouse on heating pad
steps.instruction: Position the mouse on a heating pad to maintain core body temperature.

steps.title: Administer pre‑operative analgesics
steps.instruction: Immediately before surgery, inject ketoprofen 5 mg/kg subcutaneously and buprenorphine‑XR 3.25 mg/kg subcutaneously for systemic analgesia.

steps.title: Disinfect surgical site with chlorhexidine
steps.instruction: Apply chlorhexidine scrub followed by chlorhexidine solution alternately, repeating the sequence three times to disinfect the surgical site.

steps.title: Inject local bupivacaine subcutaneously
steps.instruction: Inject 50–100 µL of 0.25 % bupivacaine in sterile saline subcutaneously over the skull for local analgesia and to keep the scalp moist.

steps.title: Make midline scalp incision
steps.instruction: Using a sterile scalpel, make a midline incision over the skull.

steps.title: Perform surgery under sterile conditions
steps.instruction: Carry out all subsequent surgical manipulations under sterile conditions using autoclave‑sterilized instruments and aseptic technique.

steps.title: Execute stereotaxic injection
steps.instruction: Using a 10 µL Hamilton syringe (Hamilton #1701) fitted with a 33‑gauge needle, perform the stereotaxic injection at the predetermined coordinates.

steps.title: Release mouse from ear bars
steps.instruction: After completing injections, gently release the mouse from the stereotaxic ear bars before closing the incision to reduce skin tension.

steps.title: Close incision with nylon sutures
steps.instruction: Close the scalp incision with non‑absorbable nylon sutures (Ethicon #NW3353), aligning wound edges properly.

steps.title: Recover mouse on heating pad
steps.instruction: Place the mouse on a heating pad and monitor until it is fully ambulatory.

steps.title: Monitor mouse post‑operatively for complications
steps.instruction: Continue regular monitoring for several days for pain, distress, or surgical complications and provide supportive care as needed.
